focus: Community CLI and MCP package/binary identity, headless boundary, feature coverage, and env contracts
noveltyJustification: The official baseline was extended with verified PyPI, npm registry, npm package-page, GitHub, Homebrew/Brew, and source-binary identities; the exact negative @clickup/mcp-server name was checked and withheld.

ruledOut: The legacy obsidian-cli name as the primary install target

claim: notesmd-cli is a verified current community Go CLI with direct filesystem operation and no running Obsidian requirement.
mcp-obsidian is a verified PyPI distribution invoked through uvx and backed by the Local REST API plugin.
obsidian-mcp-server is a verified cyanheads npm package with latest registry tag 3.2.9 and a 14-tool/3-resource MCP surface.
The canonical cyanheads configuration uses OBSIDIAN_API_KEY and OBSIDIAN_BASE_URL plus explicit MCP transport and TLS settings.
The exact @clickup/mcp-server package name did not resolve in this audit and must not be adopted without a successful registry identity check.
Do not use @questi0nm4rk/vori as the dual CRUD CLI because its documented scope is read-only query/search.
